record.title: R77 exact repository universe learning
record.body: Durable R77 learning: a portfolio census is not epistemically complete until repository identity, default branch, exact head, observation time, and authority scope are all explicit. The first R77 collector enumerated repositories/default branches but omitted exact heads; sensor 02 exposed that latent blind spot before merge. The collector was repaired to resolve every default branch through read-only branch GETs, and the permanent court now rejects collectors without `/branches/`, exact_head, head_resolved, and GET-only behavior. A second operational falsifier occurred in Project memory: bot receipt generation moved the transport head between read and write, causing an expected-head 409; re-resolution plus non-force replay succeeded. Therefore exact transport-head resolution must be treated as a per-request operation, not a run-level fact. Authority-scoped connector reachability (100 repos observed) must never be conflated with full public/account universe cardinality. Merge containment is exact: 8ecb785 parent1=04cd8add..., parent2=d79b687....
